title: Wannan kwamfuta
statusServing: Ana ba da wannan wurin aiki ga wasu na'urori
statusIdle: Ba a ba da komai a yanzu: rufe taga zai kashe Leafen
statusNothingServed: Ba a ba da komai a yanzu
keepRunningHelp: Ɓoye Leafen maimakon kashe shi idan ka rufe tagarsa ta ƙarshe, don Binciken Umarni da ba da aiki su ci gaba.
openAtLoginHelp: Yayin da wannan kwamfuta ke ba da wurin aikinta ga wasu na'urori, Leafen na buɗewa lokacin da ka shiga.
openAtLoginApproval: Ba Leafen izini a Saitunan Tsarin → Gabaɗaya → Abubuwan Shiga.
openAtLoginApprovalWindows: Kunna Leafen a Saitunan Windows → Manhajoji → Farawa.
keepAwake: Riƙe wannan kwamfuta a farke yayin da take bayarwa
keepAwakeHelp: Kwamfuta ba ta yin barci yayin da take ba da wurin aikinta ga wasu na'urori. Allon kuwa yana kashewa.
awakeOnBatteryHelp: A kashe yake da asali: idan da baturi, kwamfuta tana yin barci kamar kullum, domin saitin hana barci na tsarin ma yana aiki ne da wutar lantarki kawai.
commandSearchHelp: Gajeriyar hanya tana buɗe binciken Leafen ko da an rufe manhajar.
commandSearchShortcutHelp: Saita gajeriyar hanyar da ke buɗe Binciken Umarni.
menuBarIconHelp: Alamar da ke saman dama na allon tana kai ka Leafen da sauri.
shortcutModifierMac: Gajeriyar hanya tana buƙatar Option, Control ko Command a cikinta
shortcutModifierWindows: Gajeriyar hanya tana buƙatar Control ko Alt a cikinta
shortcutTaken: An riga an yi amfani da {{shortcut}}
failed: Ba a iya canza saitin ba. Sake gwadawa.
finishSkipped: Kammala abin da aka tsallake yayin shigarwa
